messages.content: Explain what Sensorium can access before reading my bridge.
Read this Sensorium bridge and rank the sampled places.

journeys.name: return a visible intervention

messages.content: Based on the bridged evidence, send one safe reversible experiment back to the page.

journeys.expectedOutcome: The intervention and its rationale appear in the browser activity ledger.

messages.content: Create a focus expedition called Field Desk Atlas so people in different locations can contribute comparable readings.

journeys.name: broadcast one protocol and react to live evidence

messages.content: List the field stations, ask everyone for the same quiet baseline, wait for the next update, then compare the stations.

journeys.expectedOutcome: Every joined browser shows the same human-action mission and the coordinator ranks current station readings.

journeys.name: challenge weak evidence before deciding

messages.content: Check whether the latest bridged observation is reliable enough to compare. If not, ask the person for a cleaner repeat without activating their sensors.

journeys.expectedOutcome: A quality-specific eight-second recapture mission appears in the browser mission card and shared ledger.
